title: Patomskiy Crater: The Siberian Mystery of the Shattered Stone
description:
Deep within the dense taiga of southeastern Siberia sits a massive, ring-shaped mound of limestone that defies conventional geological explanation. First documented in 1949, this formation—weighing an estimated one million tons—has baffled scientists for decades, sparking intense debate over its true origin.

We explore the history of the Patomskiy crater, examining the transition from early theories of meteorite impacts to modern studies suggesting explosive volcanic or deep-gas breakthroughs. Through the lens of dendrochronology and geophysical data, we analyze why this remote Siberian landmark continues to challenge our understanding of the earth.

What do you believe caused this massive, symmetrical mound to rise from the Siberian wilderness? Share your theories in the comments.
look: 1949 to present, remote Siberian taiga, dense forest, jagged limestone, overcast sky, muted earth tones
